deep_analysis:
No open positions — flat book during a STRONG_DOWN BTC tape. That is currently the only thing preventing losses; the recent bleed happened because the book kept leaning LONG into a market that was dumping.

Market: BTC at 81,646, below EMA300 (81,754) for 62 straight 1m candles, linreg LEAN_BEAR across 1m/5m/15m/1h, zscore NEG, both 15m and 4h regimes SHORT_BIAS, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN. Token breadth confirms: 42 SHORT_BIAS vs 4 LONG_BIAS across 127 coins. Volume and velocity are LOW/SLOW — this is a grind-down, not a crash, which is exactly the environment where counter-trend LONG bounces die slow (trail never arms, hard_max_loss bleeds out).

Last 24h accounting: LONGs n=7 -$0.27 (3W), SHORTs n=3 +$0.46 (2W, +2.2% avg). Every big recent win was a SHORT or a regime-aligned BTC trade: ALT SHORT +4.22% (pump-chain short, meta_rsi 63), BTC SHORT +4.18% (manual, max-hold exit), BTC LONG +2.39% and SUPER LONG +1.40% (the only two LONG wins — both held <5h and trailed properly). Every big loss was a LONG: ZEN -5.08%, APT -4.24%, INJ -4.44%, DOT -4.32%, CRV -4.39%, YGG -3.22%, WCT -3.44%.

The trail family still works when the trade is on the right side — ALT's SHORT trailed to +4.22% and SUPER's LONG trailed to +1.40%. hard_max_loss/trail_arm_timeout losers (IO -2.11%, BLUR -2.70%, CRV -4.39%) never reached +0.40% trail arm because they were LONGs in a SHORT_BIAS tape: chop entries, wrong side, trail irrelevant.

If opening anything fresh right now: SHORT only, RSI 55-65 (the only profitable SHORT band this week), coins with confirmed SHORT_BIAS regime (r2 > 0.7). LONG only if BTC reclaims EMA300 with bullish linreg alignment — until then every LONG is a knife catch. Pending queue signals USELESS SHORT rsi 28.4 and SAGA SHORT rsi 27.3 are oversold chases below the hard floor (35) and will bounce-risk; GRASS SHORT rsi 58.5 sits in a valid band but GRASS is ranging (slope +0.004), not trending — low conviction.

We kept firing pump-chain+/doji-bottom/ai-trader+ LONGs into it. n=10, direction split is significant enough to act on. Fix: suppress LONG ai-trader picks until BTC reclaims EMA300.

2) LONG meta_rsi 45-55 is the worst band this week: n=27, -$1.53, 22%WR (7d). LONG 55-65: n=36, +$0.16, 47%WR — the only green LONG band, matching LONG_RSI_SWEET_SPOT 55-60. 4) doji-bottom-long = falling knives in this regime. Last 5: ZEN -5.08% (rsi 29.5), CRV -4.39% (39.8), WCT -3.44% (27.8), YGG -3.22% (48.8), GMT +0.54% (56.3 sole winner). 1W/4L, avg loss -4%. ZEN is now SHORT_BIAS (conf 59.3, slope -0.043) — the winning side was SHORT the whole time. Oversold doji 'bottoms' in a STRONG_DOWN tape are pauses in the dump, not bottoms.

5) ai-trader+ LONG streak: 3 consecutive losses (WLD -0.15 rsi 52.6, INJ -0.20 rsi 64.0, APT -0.09 rsi 33.7-drift), total 25T 44%WR -$0.63. Winner side of those: WLD SHORT_BIAS conf 84.4 — shorting WLD was the trade.

6) EXTREME-vol LONGs: recent EXTREME-regime LONGs = APT -4.24%, INJ -4.44%, DOT -4.32%, WLD -0.70 vs WLD +1.04 — 1W/4L. EXTREME vol + LONG = getting run over by the dump. EXTREME-vol SHORT (ALT +4.22%) is where EXTREME pays.
